provenance: Written 2026-09-27 from the answer keys in docs/ab-token-check.md §2 (Q1 end-to-end flow of POST /api/v1/po, Q2 its error statuses, Q3 edit context for checkUserAuth), which were taken from the corpus source with file:line. Nothing here was taken from the graph: a key built from the graph rewards the graph for agreeing with itself. Each fact's `key` names the answer-key fact it comes from (Q<question>.<fact>). The API -> tables question reuses Q1's table facts 8, 9 and 11. The feature-by-description question is the phrase 'send mail' (plan §2.8) resolved to 51-integration POST /api/v1/mail/send at main.py:111 ('route :111' in Q1.11), plus Q1.10 and Q1.11.
description: Ground truth for CTX-S2's corpus mode of scripts/workflow-bench.ts (goal G5). The corpus is the four repos in config/repos.json; a fact's `file` is '<repo name>/<path inside that repo>', resolved against that repo's rootPath, so no machine path is written here. `line` is the key's first cited line; `ranges` are 1-based inclusive line ranges and are exactly the lines the key cites. The gate charges WHOLE files for both 'reading the files' and 'still to read' (owner decision, 2026-09-27); the ranges are validated against the files and reported as the 'cited lines' figure, for information. Where the key gives a line as '≈', the fact is marked `approx` and its range is widened by 10 lines each side (the note says so). `evidence` is matched as a verbatim substring of the tool responses (scoreQuestion): it is a string the key itself writes in code font, or the service or route the key names, chosen as the most specific marker of that fact. A key fact that lists several items (Q3.4's nine routes, Q3.6's exemptions) is split into one sub-fact per item, each keeping the key fact's `key`, so every item is checked. Edges are not scored in corpus mode: there is no edge truth for the corpus. Bonus items in the key are not required facts and are left out.
